name: plangate-denial-streak-hold
description: A plan-gate denial streak trips the forensic hold end to end. Phase 0 declares a budget of ONE governed call for perm:list:crm_company (mirrors plangate-call-budget's focus mechanism, deliberately: a budget-exhaustion denial needs no plan_amendment card and so no SpiceDB approver-resolution round trip inside the tool dispatch that the operator's reap could race and abort mid-flight, unlike an uncovered-permission denial). The agent lists the companies once (spends the budget), then keeps calling: three more attempts are refused by the exhausted budget, tripping the threshold=3 denial-streak tripper on the third, and a fifth attempt after that is STILL refused — proving the block outlives the exact three calls that tripped it, not a coincidence of the ceiling. The session's final phase (Held) is asserted at the Go level (checkSessionPhase in plangate_denial_streak_hold_test.go), since bt.Assertions carries no session-phase field.
